newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks mostly stable, Lode up on bonus.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks mostly stable, Lode up on bonus.

text.p: Latvian shares were mostly stable on Monday but Lode Brick maker jumped on bonus shares promised at a general shareholders' meeting last week, dealers said.
"There is no explicit upward or downward trend today," one dealer said.
Lode added 10 santimes to 2.30 lats amd traded 5,200 lats of shares after it promised last week to make a bonus issue of shares fopr existing shareholders.
Most other blue chip prices did not move, except for the official list's Riga Transport Fleet, which edged up one santime to 1.69 lats, thus regaining ground it had lost since last week.
Market leader Unibanka was stable at 4.70 lats, as was Valmiera Glassfibre on the secondary list on 2.15 lats.
Elsewhere on the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain was unchanged at 2.82 lats and Salacgriva95 stayed put at 5.20 lats.
Among other fish canneries, Liepaja edged up a whisker to 1.50 lats from 1.49, while Roja lost four santimes to 2.99 lats.
